description: The lecture's recurring picture: a simple ink Speed Post envelope (white, 3 px ink #2b2622 outline, three short postal-red #9e1b1b speed lines at its left edge, blank label strip) leaning on a sand #f3ead6 cardboard parcel with a blank white label; 520x360, no lettering, no logo. Parts #envelope, #parcel, #speed-lines.

Postal-red #9e1b1b card with a perforated stamp edge, 560x340, thin #b8403a inner line, blank for one big white figure and a pale-yellow Hindi line under it; the recurring key-fact card (500 g, 35 kg, ₹19/₹47, 13 characters, ₹5 lakh, ₹1,000).
Sand #f3ead6 cardboard box in three-quarter view, 3 px ink outline, tan tape cross on top, blank white address label with an ink barcode band; 360x300.
Open ink line drawing of a box in three-quarter view, 640x420, with three blank dimension arrows (#len, #wid, #ht) and a dashed loop round its middle (#girth-loop) to draw on; no numbers.
Four white day tiles in a row (each 240x260, 3 px ink) with a blank postal-red top band for the day name and a big blank centre; groups #day-1..#day-4 so a scene can strike or tick each.
